dct_title_s: Cocos (Keeling) Islands - Tropical storm on Mar 18 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001155\_5](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001155) Tropical storm during the period Mar 18 2025-Mar 20 2025 in Cocos (Keeling) Islands. The center of the storm was located near latitude -14.4 longitude 96.3. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
